entry.dealsHint: An offer straight to someone who approached you, by link

page.nextTitle: What happens once you take it
page.next1: The offer becomes your wish. You can change its description, dates and place, and add parts that are missing.
page.next2: On each part you can approve what {{name}} proposed, or propose another price or scope. You talk in the wish’s chat.
page.next3: Nothing is closed and nothing is paid until both sides sign the same version.
page.own: This is your own offer. Send the link to the person it is for.
page.locked: This offer was sent to a particular email address. To take it, sign in with that address’s account.
page.signupHint: Signing up is just accepting the terms. After confirming your email you come back here.

err.SIGN_IN: Sign in to take the offer.
err.FAILED: We could not take the offer right now. Please try again in a moment.
err.OFFER_SELF: This is your own offer. Send the link to the person it is for.
err.OFFER_EMAIL: This offer was written for another email address. Sign in with the account it was sent to.
err.INVALID_LINK: This link is no longer valid.

invalid.title: This link is not valid
invalid.body: It may have been replaced by a new link or closed. You can ask whoever sent it for a new one.

unavailable.title: We could not load the offer
unavailable.body: Please try again in a moment.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.body: You can ask {{name}} for a new link.

taken.title: This offer was already taken
taken.body: If it was you, sign in with the account that took it.

closed.title: This offer is closed
closed.body: You can contact whoever sent it.

list.title: Direct offers
list.intro: Approached directly? Write an offer with what you will do and at what price, and send a link. Whoever takes it gets a wish of their own with every tool: chat, exact details, and negotiation on each part.
list.loadFailed: We could not load your offers. Try refreshing.
list.empty: You have not written any offers yet.

compose.title: New direct offer
compose.intro: Write the offer as you agreed it in person. After saving you get a link to send. Whoever takes it can change details and propose otherwise on each part.
compose.recipientHint: Only you see this. For example: "Dana, a website for the studio".
compose.emailHint: If you fill it in, only the account with this email can take the offer. The address itself is not stored.
compose.name: Title
compose.partsHint: Each part is a task (hours × hourly rate) or a resource (quantity × unit price). Each part can be negotiated on its own.
compose.saveHint: Nothing is sent yet. You make the link on the next screen.

err.recipient: Say who the offer is for. Only you will see it.
err.title: The offer needs a title.
err.tooMany: Too many parts in one offer.
err.name: Every part needs a name.
err.duplicate: Two parts of the same kind cannot share a name.
err.amount: Hours, quantities and prices must be numbers, and a part cannot be empty.
err.failed: We could not save the offer. Please try again.

manage.shareText: I prepared an offer for you: {{name}}
manage.failed: That did not work, please try again
manage.copyFailed: Could not copy. You can select and copy it by hand.
manage.linkHint: Send the link any way you like. Whoever opens it sees the offer, and can take it after signing in.
manage.linkReplaced: A new link was made. The previous one no longer works.
manage.newLinkHint: A new link cancels the previous one. Closing cancels it without making a new one.
manage.noLink: There is no link yet. When you are ready, make one and send it.
manage.unlocked: anyone holding the link can take it
manage.emailReplaceHint: A new email replaces the lock. Leaving it empty keeps it as it is.
manage.claimedBody: The offer was taken and is now the customer’s wish. Each part is discussed and negotiated from there. Your parts are waiting on the deals page.
manage.termsNote: Until the offer is taken the details are yours: a change here needs nobody’s approval.
manage.partsFixed: To change the parts themselves, write a new offer. Once the offer is taken, each part is negotiated on its own.
